name: ai-frontend-optimizer
description: AI-powered Angular component analyzer for code optimization

commands.title: AI Frontend Optimizer: Configure API Key
AI Frontend Optimizer: Reset Configuration to Defaults
AI Frontend Optimizer: Compare Base Styles

enumDescriptions: Use OpenAI's GPT models for recommendations
Use Anthropic's Claude models for recommendations
Use internal AI model (requires separate configuration)
aiFrontendOptimizer.aiProvider.description: AI provider to use for generating optimization recommendations

aiFrontendOptimizer.apiKey.description: API key for AI service. Note: This will be migrated to secure storage automatically. For security, use the 'Configure API Key' command instead.
aiFrontendOptimizer.apiKey.deprecationMessage: Use the 'Configure API Key' command to store your API key securely

enumDescriptions: Claude Sonnet 4.5 - Latest and most capable Anthropic model (recommended)
Claude Sonnet 4 - Balanced performance and cost
Claude Opus 4 - Most powerful Anthropic model for complex tasks
GPT-4o - Latest and most capable OpenAI model
GPT-4o Mini - Fast and cost-effective latest model
GPT-4 Turbo - Faster and more cost-effective OpenAI model
GPT-4 - Most capable OpenAI model with best recommendations
GPT-3.5 Turbo - Fastest and most economical OpenAI option
aiFrontendOptimizer.model.description: AI model to use for generating recommendations. Make sure the model matches your selected AI provider.

aiFrontendOptimizer.maxNestingDepth.description: Maximum allowed nesting depth for loops in Angular templates. Issues will be reported when this threshold is exceeded.

aiFrontendOptimizer.analyzerTimeout.description: Timeout in seconds for analyzer execution and AI API calls. Increase this value for very large component files or slow API responses.

aiFrontendOptimizer.enableAutoAnalysis.description: Automatically analyze Angular component files when saved. Warning: This may impact performance on large projects.

aiFrontendOptimizer.skipBinaryVerificati.description: Skip binary checksum verification on startup. Only enable this for development or if you're experiencing verification issues.

aiFrontendOptimizer.verboseLogging.description: Enable verbose logging for troubleshooting. Logs will include DEBUG level messages in the output channel.

aiFrontendOptimizer.baseStyleFiles.description: Default base style files for CSS similarity comparison. These files will be used automatically when running optimization.

aiFrontendOptimizer.componentMappingYaml.description: Path to YAML file containing component mapping definitions for design system component suggestions. Leave empty to disable component suggestions.

aiFrontendOptimizer.similarityThreshold.description: Similarity threshold percentage (0-100) for CSS class comparison. Classes with similarity above this threshold will be reported as potential duplicates.

aiFrontendOptimizer.enableSimilarityScan.description: Enable CSS similarity scanning to detect duplicate styles and suggest design system classes. Disable to skip similarity analysis.

aiFrontendOptimizer.enableComponentSugge.description: Enable design system component suggestions for native HTML elements. Requires componentMappingYaml to be configured.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.build-all: npm run build-rust-all && npm run package
